summary_en: 1,800M shares (1.6% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired at ¥40.0B ceiling. Execution window: Aug 5–Dec 18, 2026. Method: ToSTNeT-3 立会外買付取引 or open-market purchase on TSE. Stated rationale: enhance per-share value as component of shareholder return policy.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On August 4, 2026, Kubota Corporation's board of directors resolved to authorize the acquisition of up to 18.0 million shares of its own common stock at a maximum outlay of ¥40.0 billion. This represents 1.6% of issued shares excluding treasury. The acquisition will be executed between August 5 and December 18, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market) or open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance per-share value as part of its shareholder return policy. At July 31, 2026, the company held 11.1 million treasury shares out of 1,127.6 million issued shares ex-treasury.
